name: Tisotumab Vedotin (tissue-factor-directed antibody-drug conjugate)
cyclesNote: continued until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

premedications.name: Ocular prophylaxis
premedications.notes: mandatory eye care to reduce ocular toxicity: topical vasoconstrictor and cooling eye pads at infusion plus topical corticosteroid eye drops around each dose; ophthalmologic examination at baseline and before each dose.

supportiveCare: Ocular adverse-event prophylaxis and monitoring (conjunctivitis, keratitis, vision changes).
Monitor for bleeding and peripheral neuropathy.
monitoring: peripheral neuropathy assessment before each dose
bleeding assessment and CBC before each dose

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher ocular toxicity or peripheral neuropathy
doseModificationRules.text: Hold and reduce tisotumab vedotin for significant ocular or neuropathic toxicity per prescribing guidance; the physician decides.

drugs.name: Tisotumab Vedotin
drugs.notes: Tisotumab vedotin 2.0 mg/kg IV on day 1 every 21 days for recurrent/metastatic cervical cancer after prior systemic therapy. Weight-based dosing is capped at a body weight of 100 kg (a per-dose ceiling of about 200 mg). Requires ocular prophylaxis. Standard Guidelines / DeVita / Harrison, general reference. DRAFT, experimental.
